newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Norilsk says cash crisis won't hit output.
newsitem.headline: Russian Norilsk says cash crisis won't hit output.

text.p: Deepening financial crisis at Russia's Norilsk Nickel metals group will not affect production or export levels, a senior company export official said on Monday.
"There is and will be absolutely no effect on production or exports," said Alexei Parshikov, director of Interrosimpex, which handles some of the Norilsk group's exports.

Norilsk said earlier on Monday that it would probably delay plans to issue by July American Depositary Receipts -- share look-alikes traded on foreign markets -- after a 1996 consolidated loss of 3.29 trillion roubles ($572 million).

Parshikov said he saw no relationship between the loss and production and export activities. "There is no relationship between the two, he said, adding, "financial crisis has been brewing there for years, and still production and exports are normal." He declined to provide figures.
Norilsk said earlier this month that first quarter nickel output at its flagship combine, part of the RAO Norilsky Nickel group, soared 11 percent year on year.
But official state figures said total Russian nickel output slipped two percent in the first quarter on year-ago levels. The Norilsk group accounts for 85 percent of Russia's total nickel production.
